subLocations.name: Sewer Keep
subLocations.lore: The tower complex used as a magic water treatment facility that purified sewage waste before it is washed into the [[River Chionthar]].

subLocations.name: Seatower of Balduran
subLocations.lore: The massive sea-fortress that rested on a rocky island in the city's bay that served as the headquarters of the [[Flaming Fist]] in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

subLocations.name: High Hall
subLocations.lore: Also known as the '''Ducal Palace'', the seat of the [[Council of Four]] in which city business was conducted.

subLocations.name: Watch Citadel
subLocations.lore: Also known as '''Stormkeep''', the headquarters of [[the Watch]] in [[Baldur's Gate]] that served as a staging area, training grounds, and a temporary holding area, when needed.

subLocations.name: Baldur's Mouth
subLocations.lore: A narrow, five-story printshop that disseminated news via [[broadsheet]]s and town criers.

subLocations.name: Harborside Hospital
subLocations.lore: Formerly [[Scarbradro's Haven]], a hospital within the [[Brampton]] district with its [[cleric]]al staff offering medical services to anyone regardless of faith. Quality of service varied depending on the patient's wealth.

subLocations.name: Wyrm's Rock
subLocations.lore: A [[granite]] fortress that loomed over the small islet that connected the bridges of [[Wyrm's Crossing]].

subLocations.name: Old Wall
subLocations.lore: The wall that encircled the affluent [[Upper City]] of [[Baldur's Gate]].

subLocations.name: Harbormaster's Office
subLocations.lore: The main civic building in the harbours of [[Baldur's Gate]].

subLocations.name: Fisher's Wharf
subLocations.lore: A pier used by fishing vessels and an occasional live-in boat roped to the docks.

subLocations.name: Silver Crescent Beach
subLocations.lore: A southwestern beach in the city and the location of a washed ashore corpse – part of a series of grizzly murders, in [[1477 DR]].

subLocations.name: Stormshore Street Dock
subLocations.lore: Docks at the southern end of [[Stormshore Street]].

subLocations.name: Athcaulyr's Stand
subLocations.lore: A wide and legless dock of note.

subLocations.name: Glaezel's Dock
subLocations.lore: A small dock that had changed many owners and names over the years. It was ran by [[Manthuran Glaezel]] of the wealthy [[Glaezel]] family in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].
